# Preserve date-like XML labels as strings in JXON parsing

Entry 721 removes implicit Date.parse conversion from JXON.parseText. Accepted code still converts boolean text and finite numeric text but otherwise returns the original string. FetchConfig feeds parsed XML to readFromXML, which passes displayName to InputSanitizer.label. A date-like provider name must not become a Date merely because its text parses as one. The inspected autoconfig test asserts an ordinary Example display name; no focused date-like regression case was found in the scoped search or added by this commit.

Scope: mailnews/base/src.
